enforcement_note: This file is an operational policy, not a security sandbox. An allowlist in an editable file does not hard-restrict anything. Real restriction comes from platform access controls and from which credentials exist where. Residual access is documented in bootstrap/.

repository_allowlist.rule: Dispatch only to a repository listed here. Never silently retarget to another repository, branch, or environment.

entries.historical_alias_note: Renamed; GitHub still redirects the old name. The plan predates the rename. Always dispatch against dexter-barber.
entries.access_note: Application probes stay read-only until BARBER-RECOVERY is activated. Activation raises this to development read_write on feature branches only.

client_contract.note: tools/dispatch reads this document directly. It derives its flat configuration contract (apiKeyEnv, apiBase, recordsDir, repositoryAllowlist, missions, allowedModelIds, maxConcurrentAgents, autoCreatePR, timeouts) from the canonical fields here; see adaptCanonicalPolicy in tools/dispatch/src/policy.js. Do not add the flat keys to this file — for a document with kind "dispatch-policy" the derived value wins, so a hand-added flat key would be silently ignored and the two shapes would drift.

api.stability: public beta; endpoints and schemas may change before general availability

dispatch_records.committed_reason: Durable agent/run IDs must survive the session that created them. A future HQ session with no access to the originating conversation recovers in-flight work by running `dispatch recover` from the repository root against these records.

hq-bootstrap-preflight.description: Read-only preflight evidence from a target repository: remote identity, working directory, dirty state, and actual HEAD versus the assigned base commit. Produces a report only.
hq-bootstrap-preflight.enforcement_note: Read-only is instructed in the task prompt and is NOT enforced by this client or by the API. A dispatched agent runs with whatever write access its own environment grants it. Treat this field as intent, not as a control.

barber-recovery.description: Barber application recovery. Not activated during bootstrap.
barber-recovery.activation_requires: an explicit owner decision; until then the barber repository stays read_only_during_bootstrap

model_policy.rule: Record DISCOVERED model IDs only. Never hard-code an alias from memory or from documentation prose. Until discovery runs against the live API, every model ID is unknown and must be represented as null.

discovery.discovery_method: GET the Cloud Agents API model-listing endpoint with DEXTER_CURSOR_API_KEY; verify the live schema at https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent/api/endpoints before relying on it.
discovery.id_shape_note: The API returns a bare `id` plus a separate `params`/`parameters` array (for example id "claude-opus-5" with effort/thinking/context parameters). The composite kebab-case slugs used for in-session subagents, such as "claude-opus-5-thinking-high", are NOT valid API model IDs and must never be sent.
discovery.available_model_ids_note: Populated verbatim from the live discovery response on 2026-09-19, in the order the API returned them. Re-run discovery rather than editing this list by hand.

selection.note: Roles map to discovery results, not to fixed aliases. Each requested_model_id below appears in available_model_ids. A null effective model always means unknown, never a default.
selection.first_party_interpretation: prefer_first_party_models is read as: prefer models Cursor serves under its own name (default/Auto, composer-2.5, grok-4.x) for bounded mechanical work, and reserve frontier vendor models for judgment-heavy roles. This is an interpretation recorded here, not a platform-enforced distinction.

hq.criteria: reliable scope, delegation, and judgment decisions

builder.criteria: Bounded implementation. Start at default_ship and escalate one tier only on real failure.

verifier.criteria: independent review; may share the builder's model

escalation.criteria: stronger reasoning, used selectively for one concrete hard architecture or debugging failure

preferences.on_preferred_model_unavailable: Substitute another discovered model of the same first-party family and record the substitution. If none fits, checkpoint and ask the owner. Never substitute a paid or third-party model to proceed.

telemetry.null_means: unknown — telemetry did not report it. Never interpret null as the requested model having taken effect.
telemetry.effective_model_evidence_required: Cite where effective-model evidence came from. If runtime telemetry does not expose it, mark it unavailable.

escalation_ladder.rule: Pick the tier at launch without asking the owner. Escalate exactly one tier, and only after the cheaper tier actually failed. Record the tier used and why.

tiers.when: Clear work, few files, styling, layout, copy, config.
State, auth, concurrency, data ownership, migrations.
The cheaper tier failed, or the work is security-sensitive.
Sonnet failed, or the owner asks. Not a normal rung.

escalation_ladder.opus_note: Reaching for Opus by default is the most expensive available habit. Coordination and judgment roles may sit higher than implementation roles; that is the exception, not licence.
escalation_ladder.native_launch_warning: Workers launched through the native agent tool rather than tools/dispatch bypass this ladder and silently inherit the coordinator's model. Route dispatches through the client so this policy is actually applied.

single_owner_roles.global_ledger_writer: one writer per ledger: workers return results, the lead updates project execution state, HQ updates portfolio state

concurrency_limits.raising_limits_requires: an owner decision recorded in the mission's decisions.md; concurrency limits are operational, not spending caps

retry_limits.launch_retry_rule: If a creation request times out, the outcome is AMBIGUOUS. Reconcile with a supported lookup before any retry. A second POST can create a duplicate worker; server-side idempotency is not assumed. Use a client task identifier in metadata or a supported name field.
retry_limits.repair_cycle_rule: One related repair cycle, then reassess the approach rather than retrying the same approach repeatedly.
retry_limits.busy_rule: Never hammer a busy agent with repeated follow-ups. Wait for a supported availability signal.

budget.paid_overage_rule: Never enable paid overage, paid provisioning, external model billing, or a paid fallback. Exhausting the included allowance is a stop condition, not a reason to spend.
budget.billing_inspected_note: Account balances, the overage toggle, and hard spending caps could not be inspected from this run. Absence of a hard cap is a labelled limitation; operational concurrency limits are not dollar caps. Platform billing controls spend — prompts do not.
budget.reuse_note: Do not re-run an already-recorded demonstration unchanged merely for ceremony.

rules: Read the key only from the verified cloud secret mechanism.
Never place a secret in Git, prompts, command arguments, transcripts, child environments, logs, or result files.
Redact request headers and secret values in all error output.
Confirm a secret exists and authenticates; never print or echo its value.
Keep unnecessary production credentials out of HQ and out of workers.

pull_requests.note: Owner instruction 2026-09-20: all product PRs open ready for review, not draft. Workers still never merge. HQ or the owner merges.

validation_before_dispatch: mission ID and scope revision are present
expected base SHA resolves in the target repository
requested model is a discovered ID, or explicitly null with discovery marked incomplete
a dispatch slot remains within concurrency limits
owned paths do not overlap another in-flight worker
required credential is present without being printed

cost_discipline.never_invent_cost: Only rawCostCents and chargedCents from dispatch usage are real numbers. Anything unmeasured is a pattern, not a figure.
cost_discipline.no_worker_for_trivial_change: A cold VM boot plus context load costs more than a one-line edit. Do it in the existing checkout instead.
cost_discipline.no_duplicate_work: Never edit in the checkout and then redo the same patch in a worker.
cost_discipline.wakes_cost_not_idleness: Idle agents cost nothing; wakes cost. Fix habits before cutting roster.
cost_discipline.roster_limit: At most one implementer, one reviewer or gate, one QA, and one database owner per product. Widen an existing role rather than adding an overlapping one.
cost_discipline.reviewer_timing: Do not wake a reviewer or QA before a PR exists.
cost_discipline.retirement: Propose retirement candidates; the owner deletes. HQ never deletes an agent.
